biotools.summary: ProteoCast is a web server that predicts, validates, and interprets missense variant effects by combining evolutionary constraint analysis of an input multiple sequence alignment (FASTA/A3M/A2M) with structural context, providing three-tier variant classification (impactful/mild/neutral) and functional linear peptide discovery in disordered regions.
